title: Hedgehog dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="26" ry="5" fill="#2a1a3a"/>

  <!-- left leg kicked up -->
  <rect x="26" y="72" width="9" height="16" rx="4" fill="#8B5A2B" transform="rotate(-25 30 72)"/>
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="84" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#5C3A1A" transform="rotate(-25 24 84)"/>

  <!-- right leg -->
  <rect x="60" y="72" width="9" height="15" rx="4" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="86" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#5C3A1A"/>

  <!-- body / belly -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="62" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#D2A46A"/>

  <!-- spines on back -->
  <g fill="#4A3020">
    <polygon points="30,52 22,38 34,44"/>
    <polygon points="38,46 32,28 44,38"/>
    <polygon points="48,43 46,24 56,36"/>
    <polygon points="58,44 58,25 66,38"/>
    <polygon points="66,49 72,33 74,46"/>
    <polygon points="70,58 82,48 76,62"/>
  </g>
  <!-- lighter spine tips for contrast -->
  <g fill="#8B6A4A">
    <polygon points="30,52 24,42 33,46"/>
    <polygon points="38,46 34,32 43,39"/>
    <polygon points="48,43 47,29 55,37"/>
    <polygon points="58,44 58,29 65,39"/>
    <polygon points="66,49 71,37 73,47"/>
    <polygon points="70,58 79,50 75,61"/>
  </g>

  <!-- left arm raised, waving -->
  <rect x="20" y="52" width="8" height="18" rx="4" fill="#D2A46A" transform="rotate(35 24 52)"/>

  <!-- right arm out -->
  <rect x="66" y="58" width="8" height="16" rx="4" fill="#D2A46A" transform="rotate(-30 66 58)"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="42" rx="16" ry="14" fill="#D2A46A"/>

  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="48" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#E8C99A"/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx="21" cy="47" r="3" fill="#3A2A1A"/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="40" r="3" fill="#2A1A0A"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="39" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M24 52 Q28 56 33 53" stroke="#5C3A1A" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#C08A50"/>

  <!-- cheerful cheek blush -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="48" r="3" fill="#E8806A" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- little motion sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFD966">
    <polygon points="14,30 16,26 18,30 16,34"/>
    <polygon points="80,26 82,22 84,26 82,30"/>
    <polygon points="86,70 88,66 90,70 88,74"/>
  </g>
</svg>
